description_en: Vachẽ Nani Bāhāḥcā, a branch of Hakha Bāhāḥ (LAL0390), is located behind the Haka Bāhāḥ and on the eastern side of a narrow street that goes from the Haka Bāhāḥ to Ikhālakhu. Thebāhāḥcāis a small courtyard (7.2 m x 7.2 m) and can be accessed through another courtyard which is attached to the street.There is nokvaḥpāḥchẽin thisbāhāḥ. The main temple of thebāhāḥcāis built against the wall of a residential building facing west, and stands on a double plinth with a stone threshold. Timber lattice work surrounds the sanctum on three sides, whilst its rear wall is shared with the residential building. Inside, a statue of Akṣobhya has been placed on a high plinth so that it faces west. The roof is a two-tiered cement structure with a stonestūpaas its finial. Aśikharakūṭotpannaparipadma caitya(187 cm high) can be found in front of the main temple structure at the centre of the courtyard. A statue of Gaṇeśa is located to the right of the temple and a statue of Hanumān can be found to its left. Both have been placed on the walls of the other buildings.Thisbāhāḥwas founded by Munirāja in 1909. Thecaityawas established prior to this in 1863, most likely by his father Dhanavantasiṃha Vajrācārya. Thisbāhāḥis managed by three Vajrācārya families who are the descendants of Munirāja.
description_ne: यो हक बाहा: (LAL0390) को शाखा विहार हो । हक बाहा:को पछाडिपट्टि नै यो बाहा: रहेको छ । वछेँ ननिमा चोकमा स्थापना गरिएको हुनाले यसलाई वछेँ ननि बाहा: भनिएको हो । धनवन्तसिंह वज्राचार्यको नाममा स्थापना गरिएको हुनाले यस बाहा:को संस्कृत नाम धनवन्तसिंह विहार रहेको हो । यसलाई विहार भनिएपनि यहाँ कुनै क्वा:पा:छेँ छैन । वछेँ ननिको पूर्वमा रहेको घरको भित्तामा टाँस्सिने गरी सानो मन्दिर बनाइएको छ । अग्लो इँटको पेटीमाथि बनाइएको मन्दिरमा दुई तहको ढुंगाको छाना राखी ढुंगाकै घण्टाकार शैलीको छाना राखिएको छ । छानामाथि ढुंगाको चैत्यलाई गजुर बनाएर स्थापना गरिएको छ । । मन्दिरमा सादा टुँडालहरू राखिएका छन् । ती टुँडालमध्ये उत्तरतर्फको एउटा टुँडाल हराइसकेको छ । मन्दिरको गर्भगृहभित्र पश्चिमाभिमुख गरी अक्षोभ्यलाई क्वा:पा:द्य:को रूपमा स्थापना गरिएको छ । गर्भगृहको ढोका कलात्मक बनाइएको छ तर ढोकामाथि कुनै तोरण राखिएको छैन । बाहा: परिसरमा एउटा शिखरकूटोत्पन्नपरिपद्म चैत्य स्थापना गरिएको छ ।यो बाहा: स्थापना हुनुभन्दा अघि नेसं ९८३ मा शिखरकूटोत्पन्नपरिपद्म चैत्य स्थापना भइसकेको थियो । पछि नेसं १०२९ मा धनवन्तसिंहको नाममा उनका छोरा मुनिराजले बुद्ध मूर्ति स्थापना गरी यसलाई बाहा: बनाइदिएका थिए । तिनै मुनिराजका सन्तानमध्ये तीन वज्राचार्य परिवारले बाहा: संचालन गरिरहेका छन् ।
brick_type: mā apā (regular fired brick), dāci apā (conical veneer brick)
monument_assessment: Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired)

historical_events.event_description: Munirāja, the founder of thebāhāḥ, established the statue of Cakrasaṃvara as theāgamadeity.
Pruscha(1975, 208) mentions that thecaityawas made by Dhanavantasiṃha Vajrācārya. However, the name of the donor could not be read from the inscription and so is unconfirmed.
Munirāja (son of Dhanavantasiṃha), his wife Puṇi Thakũ and their sons Nhukṣarāja and Harṣamuni made a Buddha shrine in the courtyard. Thereafter, it became known as abāhāḥcā.
